##### Project general facts

Celestara Residences by Al Dhana Real Estate Development is a contemporary residential building inspired by the natural elegance of the desert at sunrise. Its sculpted facade, finished in soft brown marble with dune-inspired waves, soft curves and sandy tones, creates a calm architectural presence. The building rises above a ground floor and a five-level parking podium to thirteen residential floors and a rooftop, and offers studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments, complemented by retail units at ground level.

Amenities are dedicated to wellbeing and everyday balance. The rooftop swimming pool offers a private oasis with open views over the community, while a serene yoga area provides space for mindfulness and relaxation. Residents can maintain an active routine in the fully equipped indoor gym, and families benefit from a dedicated kids' play area. Selected homes feature private swimming pools, adding an extra layer of comfort and exclusivity to the everyday living experience.

Interiors are curated with natural textures and earthy tones that bring warmth and tranquillity to every home. Gentle marble finishes and warm wooden accents create calm, elegant spaces, while floor-to-ceiling windows bring in natural light and balconies extend living areas outdoors in many layouts. Kitchens are fitted with appliances and practical storage, and bathrooms feature refined fixtures. Homes are delivered with fitted kitchens, leaving furniture to the owner's own taste.

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah Village Circle is a master-planned community at the heart of new Dubai, known for its circular layout, tree-lined streets and numerous parks. It brings together villas, townhouses and apartment buildings in a family-friendly setting, with Khansoor Park and Circle Mall close at hand for everyday leisure, shopping and dining. The community offers a calmer pace of life while staying close to the city's main districts.

Al Khail Road and Umm Suqeim Road connect the community with Palm Jumeirah, Downtown Dubai, Dubai International Airport and Al Maktoum International Airport. Dubai Miracle Garden and Dubai Autodrome are a short drive away, and residents have schools, nurseries, clinics, supermarkets and fitness centres across the community and in neighbouring districts. Walking paths, landscaped parks and community sports facilities encourage an active outdoor lifestyle close to home.

Jumeirah Village Circle is a freehold community and one of Dubai's most actively traded residential areas. Strong demand from young professionals and families supports high rental yields and steady occupancy. A central position, mature infrastructure and a wide choice of homes keep the area popular with both investors and end users seeking accessible entry points within a well-connected part of the city.
